# Parse file names and create directories for each unique file_name
import re
from collections import defaultdict

# Get all files
all_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/documents/work/meetings/', entry_type='files', recursive=False)

# Extract unique file names (without extension) from the pattern
file_names = set()
for f in all_files:
    # f is like "/home/catherine/documents/work/meetings/2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
    basename = f.split('/')[-1]
    # Split on "__"
    parts = basename.split('__')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date_part = parts[0]
        rest = parts[1]
        # Split rest on last dot to get file_name and extension
        if '.' in rest:
            file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
            file_names.add(file_name)
        else:
            # no extension? unlikely
            file_names.add(rest)
print("Unique file names:", file_names)

# Create directories for each file_name under meetings
for name in file_names:
    dir_path = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{name}/"
    # Check if directory exists
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path)
    if not exists:
        print(f"Creating directory: {dir_path}")
        apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path=dir_path, recursive=True)
    else:
        print(f"Directory already exists: {dir_path}")

# Move each file to the new location: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
for f in all_files:
    # f is like "/home/catherine/documents/work/meetings/2023-apr-05__slides.ppt"
    basename = f.split('/')[-1]
    parts = basename.split('__')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping unexpected file: {f}")
        continue
    date_part = parts[0]
    rest = parts[1]
    if '.' in rest:
        file_name, ext = rest.rsplit('.', 1)
    else:
        file_name = rest
        ext = ''
    # New file name: date.extension
    new_basename = f"{date_part}.{ext}" if ext else date_part
    # Destination path: ~/documents/work/meetings/<file_name>/<new_basename>
    dest = f"~/documents/work/meetings/{file_name}/{new_basename}"
    print(f"Moving {f} -> {dest}")
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(
        access_token=access_token,
        source_file_path=f,
        destination_file_path=dest,
        overwrite=False
    )
    print(result)
